argument: The nine extruded volumes must read as one painted monolith with a deep centre before they read as separate boxes. Occlusion, silhouette, z-shift, dark openings, and the seam field must carry the composition without interface chrome.

With readout, controls, hint, and prose hidden, the first view must leave v043's witness chord, v044's edge etch, and v045's jaw clasp. It should read as a spatial material cut, not a stock WebGL cube cluster or particle demo.

The visitor must route through an existing absence and leave at the opposite bank. Pointer, touch, keyboard, and the cut control must expose the same meaningful relation without a hover-only requirement.

A preview route must remain geometry-neutral. Completion must change actual z position, volume depth, void opening, tilt, and seam bends; a path line, status, colour, or prose cannot substitute for produced depth geometry.

The central void is not a decorative target. A bypass must refuse, and the consequence must arrive at a remote volume and a different opening so the material remembers what was removed rather than painting the hand's route.
Four through-void cuts must compound in one mass. Delete must reconstruct the exact preceding depth state and release must return to the deterministic quiet monolith.
Generated WebGL volumes, lighting, z displacement, torus voids, and seam geometry are the medium. No imported model, screenshot, texture, or stock brush effect may carry the work.

p5.brush is translated from material behaviour that participates in geometry production into an erasure passage that changes depth elsewhere. No brush preset, watercolor, hatching, grain, palette, composition, source code, example, or API surface is copied.

v046 changes medium, shape vocabulary, composition, encounter, temporal rule, and viewer task: flat material fields and opposing compression become a real-depth monolith whose only commitment is a passage through an already-existing absence.

Delete v046 if the blind object is a generic 3D box sculpture, if a bypass or same-bank gesture commits, if the hole is only a labelled target, if remote displacement is cosmetic, if later cuts reset, or if lifting is inexact.
